diagnosis: All three residual failures mention a blog post or article, which initially looked like blog-images absorbing them. That hypothesis was tested and disproved: blog-images' description was narrowed from 662 to 414 chars to give up its claim on 'cover or hero image for a blog post', and this eval was re-run. The three failures were byte-identical, while blog-images itself regressed 13/14 -> 10/14, losing its own core queries. The change was reverted. Competition is therefore ruled out as the cause.
likely_cause: skill-creator's documented triggering effect: Claude does not consult a skill for tasks it can handle directly in one step. All three are phrased as simple one-step writing requests ('write me a prompt for chatgpt image gen', 'write the prompt', 'just give me something that works anywhere'). Pushing the description harder to win them risks the negatives, which currently pass perfectly, so this is recorded rather than papered over.
note: runs-per-query=1, so individual results carry sampling noise. The three failures repeated identically across two independent runs, so they are signal.

raw.description: Writes one paste-ready image-generation prompt for ChatGPT, Gemini or Midjourney, composed fresh for the topic instead of filled into a template. Asks colour, style, format and target model first, then tunes the wording to that model. Say "image prompt for X", "poster prompt for gemini about X". For fixed-layout social sets use carousel, linkedin-infographics or shorts-creator; for authored SVG diagrams, blog-images.
